version.feature: The now playing queue now opens on the track that is playing instead of at the top, and a new top bar action jumps back to it after you have scrolled away.

On Android 17 the app now asks for permission to reach devices on your local network, which that release requires before anything can connect to MusicBee. The reason is explained before the system prompt, and if the permission is declined the app says so and offers a way back instead of endlessly showing "Connecting...".

Adds a "Keep screen on" setting under Appearance, for when the app is propped up somewhere and glanced at between tracks. Choose never, only while the device is charging, or always. It is off by default and only applies while the app is on screen.
version.bug: Fixes the home screen widget showing the previous track's album art. MusicBee sends the track and its artwork as two separate messages and the widget was only told about the first; it now follows the same information the app shows, so the artwork catches up as soon as it arrives.

Fixes the app crashing when debug logging was switched on or off. The setting was applied twice over at the same time, so turning it on could fail to open the log file and bring the app down, and turning it off could crash outright. Logging is now set up once, and a log file that cannot be opened is reported rather than fatal.

Fixes the app being unable to reconnect after it had given up. Leaving it running away from your network, or closing MusicBee for a while, could leave tapping connect doing nothing, with force-stopping the app the only way out. Connecting by hand now works from whatever state the app got into, attempts are no longer scheduled twice over and cancelled before they finish, and a connection that opens but hears nothing back now gives up instead of showing "Authenticating" indefinitely.

Fixes a crash when the app asked for its background remote-control service at a moment the system would not allow it to start (Android 12+), such as toggling the connection just as the app went to the background.

Fixes the app crashing on every launch once its cached playing-track file was damaged. The file is now rebuilt automatically instead of failing to read forever, and a failure to save the cache no longer brings the app down.

Fixes a crash on every launch for anyone updating from a very old version of the app. Databases written before the app moved to Room had no upgrade path; they are now upgraded, and the saved connections in them are carried over.

Fixes the volume slider on the Now Playing screen being hidden behind the system navigation bar on foldables and other edge-to-edge devices. The player now keeps its controls clear of the system bars in portrait, landscape and on tablets.

Restores long-press-to-stop on the play/pause button (player and mini-control). Long-pressing play/pause now stops playback, a gesture lost when the player moved to the new UI; a short tap still toggles play/pause.

Fixes the app freezing, and sometimes being closed by the system as unresponsive, when using the lock screen, notification, headset or car controls while the connection to MusicBee was down. Commands are now sent in the background, so the app stays responsive whether or not they get through.
Fixes skipping to the next or previous track also telling MusicBee to jump to the start of the track, which could reset a track that was meant to resume where you left it.

Drawer items now switch screens immediately instead of waiting for the drawer to close, and a screen already on its way out ignores further navigation. This narrows the window in which a back gesture and a screen change can disagree about which screen is on top.

Reduces the chance of a crash while scrolling a list that is still loading. Rows that had not loaded yet could share an identifier with a loaded row; every list now keeps the two apart and labels its own rows, so any remaining report says which list was involved.

Fixes the app never telling you that your MusicBee plugin is out of date. Both the warning for a plugin older than the minimum supported version and the optional "an update is available" notice were compared against a version number the app failed to read, so neither ever appeared.

Fixes the volume shown in the app ignoring updates from MusicBee when they arrived as text rather than as a number. Such an update was discarded until the next readable one arrived; volumes are now understood in either form.

Fixes long track titles, artists and albums scrolling only three times and then stopping partway through a track. They now keep scrolling for as long as they are on screen, on both the player and the mini-control. If you have turned off animations on your device the text no longer scrolls and is shortened with an ellipsis instead.

Scrolling is smoother and stutters less, most noticeably in the now playing queue on older phones and tablets. Long titles that scroll across the screen now pause between passes rather than moving constantly, which is easier on the battery too.
The app opens faster, and the queue, the library and the player appear faster the first time you visit them.

version.feature: Shows a progress bar at the top of the now playing queue while it syncs, so a long sync (opening the screen, pull-to-refresh, or a server-side "play all") gives visible feedback instead of appearing stalled.
version.bug: Fixes out-of-memory crashes on very large now playing queues. The queue now syncs one page at a time instead of loading the whole list into memory, so memory stays flat regardless of queue size. Incoming network messages are also capped relative to the available heap as a safeguard.

Fixes the now playing queue sometimes loading only part of the list. Refreshes triggered close together no longer overlap and overwrite each other; a newer refresh cancels and restarts the in-flight one, so the full queue is always loaded.
Fixes a spurious error logged on every "play all" action by handling the play-all confirmation broadcast instead of treating it as an unsupported message.

Fixes a crash when scrolling the now playing queue during a refresh. Reconciling the queue could briefly leave two entries at the same position; each position now updates in place, so an entry is never duplicated.

Fixes a crash when the system restarted the background remote-control service while the app was not in the foreground (Android 12+). The service no longer asks to be auto-recreated in the background and stops gracefully instead of crashing if a foreground start is denied.

version.feature: Restores the sync action on the library top app bar, so a sync can be triggered without going through the empty-state button or settings.
Adds a visible delete button on each connection row in the connection manager, with a confirmation dialog. Swipe-to-delete still works for power users.
Network discovery now finds every MusicBee plugin on the LAN in a single scan, with re-broadcasts to combat multicast packet loss.
Long track titles, artists, and albums now scroll (marquee) on the player and mini-control instead of being cut off, so the full text is readable.
version.bug: Fixes accidental track removal while scrolling the now playing queue: swipe-to-remove now triggers only on a deliberate right-to-left swipe, Remove is also available from the row overflow menu, and reorder is started from the drag handle on the right of each row.
Fixes the left-edge swipe-to-open gesture for the navigation drawer not working on the now playing screen.
Fixes the now playing queue capping at 100 items so the full queue is reachable on scroll.
Fixes pull-to-refresh not triggering when the now playing queue is empty.
Fixes drag-and-drop reorder snapping back when a new page loaded mid-drag, and now lets users reorder across page boundaries.
Fixes a crash when the server returned a bare empty array for paged library responses; pagination now terminates cleanly.
Fixes an out-of-memory crash on the socket message pipeline by bounding the incoming-message buffer and dropping the oldest queued message under burst load.
Fixes a crash when navigating into an album, artist, or genre whose name contains a literal % (e.g. "100% Hits"). Route arguments now round-trip cleanly through the navigation back stack.
Fixes a crash on track change when the plugin omits the year field for tracks without a year tag.
Fixes a home screen widget crash when tapping the widget to open the app, by launching the activity directly instead of routing through a Glance action callback.
Fixes a crash when a broadcast action throws, by catching exceptions in the message handler and swallowing the no-default-connection error during now-playing refresh.
Fixes the app License screen failing to load because the bundled LICENSE.txt asset was missing from the APK.
Fixes a crash when opening the output selection (or any other API call) before a default connection is configured.
Fixes a crash when the plugin sends a cover protocol message with a null cover field.
Fixes a startup crash for users upgrading from legacy versions caused by a type mismatch on the stored last-run version code.
Fixes Google Services configuration for the Play release build.
